reviewer_requested: GPT-6.1 Sol XHigh independent technical review

scope.source_tree: First-party Package-G code and new publication files only; external dependency package code, wheels, environments, models and runtime binary artifacts are excluded.
scope.first_party_deps_directory: runtime/candidate/deps contains tracked Package-G project sources, not an installed site-packages copy.
scope.first_party_authorization: Current Owner instruction authorizes Apache-2.0 publication of owned project code; private source provenance map retains exact origins. No conflicting third-party notice was observed in inspected first-party source files.
scope.ownership_claim_limit: This evidence review does not manufacture copyright records or independently certify exclusive title.

test_version_basis: Exact installed versions supplied for the publication test environment and independently measured here; six test-only package versions appear in their rows.
method: Read installed distribution METADATA with importlib.metadata; imported no dependency runtime code to collect licenses.
Read every declared License-File, all matching installed license/notice files, and included author files; record path, byte length and SHA-256.
Review actual grant/condition/disclaimer text against the metadata expression; retain multi-license exceptions rather than collapsing them to a package classifier.
Cross-check all 29 runtime metadata and license evidence identities between historical campaign environment and new publication environment.
No dependency code, wheel, environment or executable is redistributed by this source-only snapshot.

findings.finding: Legacy PSF metadata understates the installed multi-license component notices; adodbapi includes LGPL2.1 text and other components retain BSD-style, MIT, Scintilla and Python terms.
findings.disposition: Preserve the exact per-component observations here. Do not claim that the external pywin32 distribution is Apache-only or entirely PSF. Its code is not vendored.

findings.finding: No SPDX expression in metadata; actual LICENSE.txt supplies the three BSD conditions.
findings.disposition: Observed BSD-3-Clause classification is bound to the actual license file hash, not invented metadata.

unresolved_scope_limits: No all-components relicensing or binary/wheel redistribution opinion is issued. Bundling third-party packages later requires retaining and satisfying their exact component terms.
pywin32 adodbapi only-versus-or-later grant and ISAPI standalone license expression are not inferred from the installed notice texts; these external components are not distributed by this snapshot.
This audit identifies actual installed versions and license texts, not package-index authenticity, supply-chain security, or an offline installation guarantee.
